programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: Mike and Elvis attempt to resuscitate the 'daddy' of British executive saloons: a 1974 Jaguar XJ6. But it's a risky buy: it hasn't been on the road since 1990!

programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: Wayde and Brett build a giant bar aquarium for the owners of Creek Casino in Alabama. This tank marks ATM's 10,000th tank and is one of the largest they've ever built.

programs.title: Gold Rush
programs.desc: Todd Hoffman's crew has quit, and he desperately tries to keep mining with a skeleton team. Parker Schnabel carelessly breaks his truck's air hoses while transporting his washplant, and Tony Beets discovers his dredge is blowing gold out of the sluices.

programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Top salvage expert Drew Pritchard breaks new ground with his first ever buying trip to Northern Ireland, where he gets trollied and falls for a vintage Japanese beauty.

programs.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programs.desc: Brothers Rick and Marty Lagina believe they may actually be on the cusp of making a monumental breakthrough on the island after discovering something very unusual that could finally unlock its long-held secrets once and for all.

programs.title: Expedition Unknown
programs.desc: Josh searches for a top-secret WWII seaplane that crashed into the Pacific. Now, 70 years later, Josh joins a team scouring the ocean floor hundreds of feet below to find a lost aviation treasure -- the only XP5Y-1 still in existence.
